ICAR IARI Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position at ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a postgraduate degree in basic science (Life Sciences) or a graduate/postgraduate degree in professional courses (Life Sciences or Agricultural Sciences).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi - 110012.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position for Young Professional-II (YP-II) at ICAR IARI.
